$comment: The Steamworks app and depot ids, which the packaging and upload steps write
into their VDF. Fill them in from the partner site once the app exists:
App Admin → the number in the URL is the appId; App Admin → Depots for the
rest, one per platform the desktop shell ships.
COMMITTED rather than gitignored, because these are identifiers and not
secrets — every machine that builds a release needs the same values, and
they are visible in any store URL. The CREDENTIAL half (a Steamworks login
and its build account) never comes near this file.
480 IS NOT A DEFAULT — it is Spacewar, Valve's shared test app. Everything
works against it: the build uploads, the page renders, into a sandbox every
developer on Steam shares. `make store-preflight` fails on it by name,
because it is the quietest failure in the whole submission.
